# Load data

Load the larval data from Pandey et al. (2018). 
```{r}

library("data.table")


read_scs = function(file){
  dt = fread(file)
  dtmt = as.matrix(dt[, -1])
rownames(dtmt) = dt[, V1]
colnames(dtmt) = colnames(dt)[-1]
return(dtmt)
  
}

create_scs = function(counts,metadata=NULL){
  # Create list and name list elements 
  list_out <- vector(mode = "list", length = 3)
  names(list_out) <- c("counts", "initial_dim", "metadata")
  
  # counts data 
  list_out$counts <- counts
  
  #  `initial_dim`: a vector containing the initial number of genes and cells contained in the raw counts data file; let the names of the vectors indicate which component contains genes and which contains cells
  dimdata <- dim(counts)
  names(dimdata)<- c("gene","cell")
  list_out$initial_dim <- dimdata
  
  # `metadata`: dataframe of metadata
  list_out$metadata <- metadata
  
  
  # output
  return(list_out)
  
  
}

qc_scs = function(scs, min_cells=0, min_features=0, mt_genes=NULL, max_mt=100){
  
# get genes less than min_cells 
#   * `min_cells`: remove genes that were detected in less than `min_cells` cells; default value = 0
# rowSums(obj[['counts']] != 0 counts non-zero elements of the row, counting cells that contain that gene. 

to_rm_genes <- names(which(rowSums(scs[['counts']] != 0 ) < min_cells))

# get cell IDs with less than 'min_features' detected genes
# * `min_features`: remove cells that contain less than `min_features` detected genes; default value = 0
# colSums(obj[['counts']] != 0 counts non-zero elements of the col, counting number of non-zero count genes in the cell that. 

to_rm_cells <- names(which(colSums(scs[['counts']] != 0 ) < min_features))


# if mt_gene is provided calculate percentage of mt gene and get cell IDs above max_mt 
if (!is.null(mt_genes)){
  tmpscs = percentage_features(scs, mt,"percent_mt") 
  
  to_rm_cells_mt <- rownames(tmpscs$metadata)[which(tmpscs$metadata > max_mt )]
  
} else {
  
  tmpscs <- scs 
}


# remove genes and cells 

tmpscs = rm_cells(tmpscs, to_rm_cells) 
tmpscs = rm_genes(tmpscs, to_rm_genes)
tmpscs = rm_cells(tmpscs, to_rm_cells_mt)   

return(tmpscs)
  
  
}


percentage_features = function(scs, features, name){
  
  # get the count matrix 
  ctmat <- scs$counts 

  # get genes containing features expression 
  
  ftarr <- character()
  for (i in 1:length(features)){
    ft = grep(features[i], rownames(ctmat), value = TRUE)
    ftarr <- append(ftarr, ft)
  }

  # feature counts / total counts to get percentage 
  ftsum <- colSums(ctmat[ftarr,])
  totsum <- colSums(ctmat)

  perc <- ftsum/totsum 
  perc <- perc*100
  
  # If no metadata create metadata 
  if (is.null(scs$metadata)){
    scs$metadata <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=length(perc), ncol=0))
    rownames(scs$metadata) <- names(perc)
  } 
  
  # Add "name" column to metatdata and add calc'd percentage
  scs$metadata[name] <- data.frame(perc ) 
  
  return(scs)

}

rm_cells = function(scs,to_rm){
  
  rm_out <- list()
  
  rm_out$initial_dim <- scs$initial_dim
  rm_out$metadata <- scs$metadata 
  
  
  # remove cells with IDs in to_rm
  rm_out$counts <- scs$counts[,setdiff(colnames(scs$counts),to_rm)]
  
  # remove from metadata 
  if (!is.null(scs$metadata)){
  rm_out$metadata <- scs$metadata[setdiff(rownames(scs$metadata),to_rm),,drop=FALSE]
  
  }
  
  return(rm_out)
  
}

rm_genes = function(scs,to_rm){
  
  rm_out <- list()
  
  rm_out$initial_dim <- scs$initial_dim
  rm_out$metadata <- scs$metadata 
  
  # remove genes in to_rm
  rm_out$counts <- scs$counts[setdiff(rownames(scs$counts),to_rm),]

  return(rm_out)
  
}




larva = read_scs('E:\\BOX\\Box\\DataScienceResource\\Upload to GIthub\\R\\GSM2818521_larva_counts_matrix.txt.gz')
obj = create_scs(larva)
mt = grep("^MT-", rownames(larva), value = TRUE)
obj = qc_scs(scs = obj,
             min_cells = 30, 
             min_features = 300,
             mt_genes = mt,
             max_mt = 6)
```

# Normalize

```{r}



normalize_scs = function(scs, scale_factor=10000){
  
  cts <- scs$counts 
  
  # add all gene counts per cell 
  totcts <- colSums(cts)
  
  # normalize 
  normcounts <- t(t(cts)/totcts*scale_factor)
  normcounts <- log(normcounts +1 )
  
  # insert results into 'normalized' 
  scs$normalized <- normcounts
  
  return(scs)
  
}

obj = normalize_scs(scs = obj, scale_factor = 10000)
str(obj)
```



# print variables in obj's metadata 

```{r}

get_vars_scs = function(scs) {
  
  var_names <- names(scs$metadata)
  
  return(var_names)

}


get_vars_scs(scs = obj)
```


# Run multiple linear regression on each gene’s normalized expression measurements on a variables (vars_to_regress) and then saves the residuals.

```{r}
variation_adjust_scs = function(scs,vars_to_regress=NULL){
  tmp <- scs 
  ctnorm <- tmp$normalized
  mtpc <- tmp$metadata[vars_to_regress]
  mtpc <- unlist(mtpc)

  
  
    
    for (i in 1:dim(ctnorm)[1]){
    
    if (is.null(vars_to_regress)){ 
    # lm for intercept only for each gene 
    ct.lm <- lm(ctnorm[i,]~1)
    } else {
    # lm for each gene 
    ct.lm <- lm(ctnorm[i,] ~ mtpc)
    }
    # calc residual and replace 
    ct.res <- resid(ct.lm)
    ctnorm[i,] <- ct.res  
        
    if(i %% 1000 == 0 ){
      print(i)
    }
    }
  tmp$corrected <- ctnorm
  return(tmp)  
  }
  

  
obj = variation_adjust_scs(scs=obj,vars_to_regress = "percent_mt")

str(obj)
```

# Identify the most variable genes using num of features are input. 


```{r}
library(matrixStats)
variable_feat_scs = function(scs, nfeatures = 2000){
  
  tmp <- scs$corrected
  tmpvar <- rowVars(tmp)
  tmpdf <- matrix(tmpvar)
  row.names(tmpdf) <- row.names(tmp)
  maxvargene <- tmpdf[order(tmpdf,decreasing = TRUE),,drop=FALSE]
  maxvar_names <- row.names(maxvargene[1:nfeatures,,drop=FALSE])
  return(maxvar_names)
  # return(maxvargene)
}
```

```{r}
var_feat = variable_feat_scs(scs = obj, nfeatures = 1000)
head(var_feat)
```

# Perform PCA. 

```{r}
run_pca = function(scs, features, npcs){
  
  # get genes in features from normalized count and run pca 
  nvar <- features
  cts.pca  <- prcomp(t(scs$normalized[nvar,]), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE, rank=npcs)
  
  # get first npcs 
  scs$PCA <- cts.pca$x
  
  return(scs)
}

obj = run_pca(obj,var_feat,10)
str(obj)


```

# Get shared nearest neighor network using dbscan library using k = 20, number of nearest neighbors and kt =3, threshold for connection. 

```{r}

library("dbscan")

make_snn = function(scs, k, kt){
  
  dt <- scs$PCA
  nn <- sNN(dt, k=k, kt=kt)

  scs$snn <- nn 
  return(scs)
}


obj = make_snn(obj, k=20, kt=3)

str(obj)
```
 
# Identify clusters using cluster_louvain in igraph library. 

```{r}
library("igraph")


find_clusters = function(scs){
  tmp <- scs$snn 
  adj <- adjacencylist(tmp)
  g <- graph_from_adj_list(adj, mode = "all", duplicate = FALSE)
  clstr <- cluster_louvain(g)
  
  scs$metadata$cluster <- as.factor(membership(clstr))
  return(scs)
}

obj = find_clusters(obj)
head(obj$metadata)
```

# Run UMAP using previous results PCA + Clustering 


```{r}


library('umap')
run_umap = function(scs){
  
  res = umap(scs$PCA)
  scs$UMAP = res$layout
  return(scs)
  
}

obj = run_umap(obj)
str(obj)

```

# Visualize UMAP 

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
viz_scs = function(scs, feature){
  tmp <- scs[[feature]]
  tmp <- as.data.frame(tmp)


ggplot(
  tmp, 
  aes(x=V1,
      y=V2,
      color = scs$metadata$cluster )
) +
  geom_point() + 
  xlab('UMAP1') + ylab('UMAP2')
  
}

viz_scs(obj,'UMAP')
```
